center_banners.sidi_salem: Sidi Salem weather is a copy of Baltim's grid cell, not an independent measurement.
center_banners.desouk: Desouk weather looks warmer than satellite surface temperature suggests, so do not compare its water figures with Baltim or Sidi Salem.
center_banners.baltim: Soil salinity here is a class-level estimate; crops marked as likely not viable may not be viable if the estimate is right.
center_banners.sidi_salem_salinity: Soil salinity here is a class-level estimate; crops marked as likely not viable may not be viable if the estimate is right.

tooltips.water: Net irrigation need = crop water use (ETc) minus 80% of rainfall, averaged over 2016-2025. Use it to compare options, not to plan irrigation volumes. Dataset rainfall is higher than the FAO text, so the need may be underestimated.
tooltips.income: Relative level of net return per feddan for economic year 2022/2023 only. Prices and costs change. Never add the two crops together.
tooltips.soil: Score from nitrogen fixing, family and root diversity and ground cover. Soil carbon comes from a modeled 250 m estimate, not a field measurement.
tooltips.salinity: Class-level estimate of soil salinity (EC); its measurement type is not confirmed. Check the field's EC before deciding.
tooltips.overlap: Days per year when two crops would be in the field together, based on approximate sowing dates.
tooltips.bare: Days per year with no crop, calculated from the crop calendar (not from satellite NDVI).

glossary.ET0: Reference evapotranspiration: how much water a standard grass surface would use. Used here only to compare crops.
glossary.ETc: Crop evapotranspiration: ET0 multiplied by a crop factor (Kc). The water a crop uses.
glossary.Net irrigation need: ETc minus effective rain (80% of dataset rain).
glossary.NDVI: A satellite greenness index from 0 to 1. At center level it cannot show individual bare fields.
glossary.EC: Electrical conductivity, a measure of soil salinity in dS/m.
glossary.Fallow: A season with no crop planted.
glossary.Overlap: Days when the end of one crop and the start of the next fall on the same field.

limitations_to_add_to_meta: Some suggested plans include crops (maize, faba bean, rice) whose estimated relative yield at the estimated salinity of Baltim and Sidi Salem is 0%. They may not be viable if the field's salinity is as estimated; the salinity value is a class-level estimate and its measurement type is not confirmed.

Desouk's weather comes from a NASA POWER grid cell whose temperatures look much higher than satellite surface temperature suggests (about 119 hot days per year versus about 6 on the coast). Desouk's water demand may be overstated, so do not compare Desouk's water figures with Baltim or Sidi Salem.
Cotton and maize sowing dates are approximate and not Egyptian; they also affect overlap days and the ranking of plans that include these crops.
Plans are ranked with a salinity adjustment, so a water-saving plan can use more water than the current plan. When this happens, the water change is shown on the plan.
